name: Expanded Paladin Spell List
body:
You expand your divine spellcasting.

Prerequisites: Paladin level 4, Caster level 1

Benefit: Add one cleric spell per spell level to your paladin class spell list.

Special: This feat may be taken multiple times. Each time it’s taken, you may select another spell.
